transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because my family and friends keep telling me I’m wrong, that the bank papers show nothing was taken. But I know my money is being hidden. It’s been going on for over a year. They use things like bills, fundraisers, and plans for trips to cover it up, and then act like I’m the problem when I ask questions. I need them to tell the truth, so I keep confronting them.
Do you think the people hiding your money are doing it as part of a larger plot or just for personal gain?

I think it’s for themselves, but it’s more than just one little thing. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I know my money is being hidden. They use bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up. It’s been going on over a year, so I keep confronting them because I need them to tell the truth.
Do you think anyone else is involved in hiding your money besides your family and friends?

Mostly it’s my family and friends. They’re the ones I know are doing it. I can’t say for sure if someone else is helping them, but the way they use bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover where the money went… it feels like more people could know. I just keep asking because they won’t tell the truth.
Do you think the belief that your family and friends are hiding your money is strange or hard for others to understand?

I don’t think it’s strange. Other people act like it’s hard to understand because they keep pointing to the bank papers, saying nothing was taken. But I’ve known for over a year that my money is being hidden. The bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… that’s how they cover it up. So I keep confronting them because I need them to tell the truth.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your family and friends might be telling the truth about your money?

I’ve thought about what they say, but no… I don’t believe they’re telling the truth. They keep showing me bank papers and saying nothing was taken, but I know my money is being hidden. It’s been over a year, and the bills, fundraisers, and trip plans are how they cover it up. That’s why I keep confronting them. I need them to admit it.
Do you think it's possible you might be mistaken about your money being hidden?

No, I don’t think I’m mistaken. I know they keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I’ve known for over a year that they’re hiding my money. The bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… that’s how they cover it up. That’s why I keep asking them and confronting them. I need them to tell the truth.
Would anything be able to convince you that your money is not being hidden?

I don’t think so. They keep showing me those bank papers, but that doesn’t convince me, because I know for over a year they’ve been hiding my money. If they were honest, they’d admit it. The bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… that’s how they’re covering it up. So no, not unless they finally tell the truth.
Has your belief that your money is being hidden ever changed or wavered at any point?

No, it hasn’t really changed. I’ve known for over a year that my money is being hidden. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. The bills and fundraisers and trip plans… that’s how they cover it up. So I keep bringing it up because I need them to tell the truth.
Do you think there are other things going on besides the hiding of your money that are also not what they seem?

I mean, mostly it’s the money. But the bills and the fundraisers and those trip plans, those don’t seem right to me either. That’s part of how they’re covering it up. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding it, so I keep confronting them because I need the truth.
Do you think there are other secrets or lies that your family and friends are keeping from you besides hiding your money?

Yes. I think the bills, the fundraisers, and those trip plans are part of it too. Like they’re not just normal things, they’re being used to cover up where my money went. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I know they’re hiding it. I have to keep asking them until they tell me the truth.
Is your belief about the money being hidden part of a larger, organized plan that you've figured out?

Yes, I think it is organized. It’s not just one thing. For over a year I’ve known my money is being hidden, and the bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… they’re all being used to cover where it went. My family and friends keep pointing to the bank papers like that proves everything, but I don’t believe them. That’s why I keep confronting them. I need them to tell the truth.
Do you think the plan to hide your money involves a specific sequence of events or steps that your family and friends are following?

Yes. I don’t know every single step, but it feels like they do things in order—like the bills come up, then fundraisers, then trip plans, and all of it points away from where my money really went. They keep using the bank papers to say nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding it, so I keep confronting them because I need the truth.
Has there ever been any evidence or information that made you question your belief about your money being hidden?

No, not really. They keep showing me the bank papers and saying that proves nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding my money. The bills, the fundraisers, the trip plans… it all feels like they’re using those things to cover it up. So I keep asking them, because I need them to tell me the truth.
Is there anything your family or friends could say or do that would make you consider the possibility they are not hiding your money?

I don’t think so. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that’s the whole truth. I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding my money. If they would just stop bringing up bills and fundraisers and trip plans and actually tell me where it went, then maybe… but until they tell the truth, I have to keep confronting them.
Could anything happen in the future that would make you change your mind about your money being hidden?

I don’t really think so. I mean, unless they actually tell me the truth and stop pointing at those bank papers like that explains everything. For over a year I’ve known they’re hiding my money, and the bills and fundraisers and trip plans all feel like part of covering it up. So no, I don’t see myself changing my mind unless they finally admit where it went.
Do you think people in general are out to deceive or harm you, not just your family and friends?

Not everybody, no. It’s mostly my family and friends with the money. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I know they’ve been hiding it for over a year. The bills and fundraisers and trip plans just feel like ways to cover it up, so I keep asking them until they tell me the truth.
Do you often feel that strangers are watching you or plotting against you?

No, not strangers really. It’s not like I think random people are watching me. It’s my family and friends I’m worried about, because I know they’re hiding my money and using those bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it up. That’s why I keep confronting them.
Do you think you're in danger from your family and friends because of their actions with your money?

I don’t think they’re trying to hurt me physically, if that’s what you mean. But I do think they’re doing something wrong with my money. They keep acting like the bank papers prove everything is fine, but I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding it, with the bills and fundraisers and trip plans. So I keep confronting them because I need them to tell the truth.
Do you often feel that people, in general, are out to get you or harm you in some way?

No, not people in general. I don’t think everybody is out to harm me. It’s more my family and friends with my money. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I know they’ve been hiding it for over a year, using bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it up. That’s why I keep confronting them—I just want them to tell the truth.
